opening.argument: The video promotes a “Metamask Trading Bot / Pancakeswap, Poocoin Auto Trading / FREE BOT + TUTORIAL,” presenting an automated tool for crypto trading. It directs viewers to an external download link and supplies the associated file password, while the displayed application shows token-contract, amount, and gas fields alongside “APPROVE,” “BUY,” “SELL,” and “GET BALANCE” controls. These observable details connect the solicitation and download instructions to crypto asset trading activity and support the claimed category. The available evidence does not depend on a completed loss, verified malware behavior, or a proven outcome, but those limitations do not change what is being promoted: a free crypto auto-trading bot tutorial distributed through an external file download.
